summary: Iteration 75: Blog Section Testing - All 21 blogs verified. 7 new Saudi Arabia blogs added and working correctly. RSS feed (21 items), news-sitemap (21 URLs), and main sitemap (22 blog URLs) all updated. Blog routes work for both logged-in and logged-out users. Executive Dashboard and Configuration page load correctly.

TEST_01_blog_index_loads.notes: Blog index page loads at /blog with data-testid='blog-index-page'

TEST_02_all_21_blog_cards.notes: Found 21 blog cards in grid, All(21) category count correct

TEST_03_saudi_arabia_category.notes: Saudi Arabia (7) category filter shows exactly 7 posts

TEST_04_category_filters.notes: 7 category filters work: All(21), Software Reviews(2), How-To Guides(4), Industry Concepts(2), Data & Research(1), KPIs & Metrics(3), AI & Technology(2), Saudi Arabia(7)

TEST_05_saudi_blog_renders.notes: Individual Saudi blog post at /blog/saudi-vision-2030-retail-demand-planning renders correctly

TEST_06_getmyplan_hyperlinks.notes: GetMyPlan.in references found in Saudi blog content (4 references)

TEST_07_tables_present.notes: 4 tables found in Saudi blog content

TEST_09_json_ld_schema.notes: JSON-LD Article schema with @type='Article', author='Founder & CEO, GetMyPlan', publisher='GetMyPlan'

TEST_11_blog_logged_in.notes: /blog route works when user is logged in (not intercepted by AuthenticatedApp)

TEST_12_blog_post_logged_in.notes: /blog/:slug route works when user is logged in

TEST_13_rss_feed.notes: RSS feed at /blog/rss.xml contains 21 items (all blog posts)

TEST_15_main_sitemap.notes: Main sitemap at /sitemap.xml contains 22 blog URLs (1 index + 21 posts)

TEST_16_executive_dashboard.notes: Executive Dashboard at /dashboard loads with KPI cards (Total Revenue, Units Sold, MRP Realisation, Health Score) and Revenue Trend chart

TEST_17_configuration_page.notes: Configuration page at /config loads with parameters (PSA Benchmark, Cover Days, ROS Period, etc.) and Save Changes button

App.js: Blog routes (lines 264-266) in public section before auth check
Blog accessible when logged in and logged out
ExecutiveDashboard: KPI cards: Total Revenue, Units Sold, MRP Realisation, Health Score
Configuration: Analysis Parameters: PSA Benchmark, Cover Days, ROS Period, Ideal DOH, Topseller X Factor, Lead Time Days, Safety Stock Days, Min Shelf Life Days
